targetedFix.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: independently reusable 2D game boss sprite with genuine transparent alpha.
Input image: edit target. Preserve the blockosaur character's exact overall silhouette, teal/coral/yellow palette, thick near-black contour, component arrangement, orthographic 65-degree camera, facing direction, facial expression, teeth, legs, back plates, and tail.
Primary edit: remove EVERY surrounding glow, halo, colored haze, smoke, aura, cast shadow, ground shadow, and stray effect pixel outside the character contour. Pixels beyond the outer black character contour must be alpha 0.
Reframe only as needed so the complete head, snout, tail, back plates, and all feet fit with about 12% transparent margin on every side.
Keep the character as clean flat solid color planes with crisp readable edges. No gradients or glossy lighting. Do not redesign, add, remove, crop, or obscure character parts.
No scene, floor, UI, dogs, text, border, effects, weapons, or debris. Output exactly one isolated blockosaur boss on a genuinely transparent background.
